newsitem.title: USA: Vanguard to reopens Primecap fund.
newsitem.headline: Vanguard to reopens Primecap fund.

text.p: Vanguard Group said it will reopen the Vanguard/Primecap Fund, effective Oct 31.
The $3.9 billion growth fund has had about 80 percent of its portfolio invested in common stocks expected to show rapid earnings growth.
The fund was closed to new investors in March 1995, after net cash inflow accelerated too quickly. The fund had $2 billion in assets when it closed.

"The speculative fervor that surrounded the fund 18 months ago has dissipated to the point that we now feel comfortable reopening the fund to investors," Vanguard president John Brennan said in a statement.
